Precision.title: Precision in Every Detail
Precision.subtitle: Custom watchmaking is not just about looks. It's about the perfect synergy of premium parts, proven movements, and precise human craftsmanship.
Precision.f1Desc: Every watch is carefully assembled by our experienced watchmakers. Focus on absolute cleanliness and precision.
Precision.f2Desc: We exclusively use proven Seiko calibers (NH35/NH34) with excellent reliability and power reserve.
Precision.f3Desc: The foundation of our custom builds is highly durable sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating for perfect legibility.

WatchCrafting.t1: A heart that never skips a beat
WatchCrafting.d1: The core of every watch we build is uncompromising reliability. We exclusively use original Seiko movements (NH35, NH34 GMT). These legendary Japanese calibers ensure that your custom watch not only looks perfect but becomes a precise companion for decades.
WatchCrafting.d2: For our elegant and sporty models, we use exclusively premium watch parts. Extremely hard sapphire crystals, fade-resistant ceramic bezels, and premium surgical steel bracelets elevate every Datejust, GMT, or Nautilus style model to true luxury.
WatchCrafting.d3: We are leading specialists in custom watchmaking. Every model from our collection goes through careful hand assembly. The result is a perfect premium timepiece with respect to traditional watchmaking and an emphasis on the smallest details.

Footer.description: Custom watchmaking from premium Seiko parts. Each piece is a unique masterpiece with an emphasis on absolute precision and detail.

About.heroSubtitle: At Vexx Watch Atelier, we don't believe in compromises. From an empty case, we create unique timepieces with respect to traditional watchmaking.
About.philDesc1: Our journey began with a passion for mechanical watches. We are not satisfied with mass production. We believe a watch is an expression of its wearer's personality.
About.philDesc2: That's why every piece is hand-assembled, part by part. We carefully select the highest quality materials and combine them to achieve perfect harmony between design and reliability.
About.d1: Extreme scratch resistance and anti-reflective coating for perfect readability in all conditions.
About.d2: UV resistance, lasting shine, and absolute scratch resistance.
About.d3: The heart of our builds are proven Seiko automatic movements (NH35, NH34 GMT), calibrated for maximum precision.
About.d4: We use stainless steel cases and bracelets (316L or 904L) for longevity and beautiful shine.
About.ctaDesc: Design a watch that will accompany you for a lifetime.

Legal.title: Legal Notice & Transparency
Legal.p1: Vexx Watch Atelier has no commercial, organizational, or legal affiliation with the Seiko® brand or any other mentioned brands. We are not an authorized dealer, partner, or licensee. All brand names mentioned on this website serve exclusively to objectively describe style, compatibility, or technical features.
Legal.p2: Our custom builds (Seiko Mods) are created entirely independently and without any authorization or approval from Seiko®. The design of our watches is inspired by iconic styles and models, but it is independent handcrafted work.
Legal.p3: Our watches are built on original automatic Seiko movements (e.g., NH35, NH34 calibers, etc.), which we then pair with carefully selected non-original (aftermarket) premium parts. This includes the use of individually selected components such as cases, dials, hands, bezels, and straps.
Legal.p4: Each of our custom builds is a hand-assembled original. It intentionally differs from mass-produced models, represents a unique artistic expression of its wearer, and is in no way a counterfeit.

Shipping.title: Shipping and Payment
Shipping.p1: Given the nature of our goods, we ensure maximum security during transport. All shipments are fully insured for the full value of the watch.
Shipping.l1: Packeta (Pickup points): 89 CZK for all orders. Reliable delivery to your selected pickup point.
Shipping.p2: If watches are marked as "In Stock", we usually dispatch them within 2 working days (after final inspection and pressure testing). For custom builds, delivery time is usually 2-4 weeks depending on the availability of specific premium parts.
Shipping.l3: Online Card Payment: Free. Instant and secure payment via Stripe (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay).
Shipping.l4: Cash on Delivery (COD): 89 CZK. Pay for the goods upon delivery.

Returns.title: Claims and Returns
Returns.p1: We provide a 24-month warranty on all our watches (assembled pieces and custom builds) for manufacturing defects and accuracy within the tolerances of the given Seiko movement. The warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, damage caused by careless handling, or dropping on a hard surface.
Returns.p2: Catalog models (In stock): You have the right to withdraw from the contract without giving any reason within 14 days of receiving the goods. The watch must be unworn, undamaged, and in its original packaging.
Returns.p3: Custom builds: For watches assembled exactly according to your individual requirements (custom production), the right to withdraw from the contract within the 14-day period expires, as this is goods modified according to the consumer's wishes.
Returns.h3: How to proceed with a claim
Returns.l1: First, contact us by email at info@vexxwatch.cz with a description of the defect and possibly photos.
Returns.l2: Wait for our shipping instructions. Always pack the watch well, ideally in the original box.
Returns.l3: We will process the claim as quickly as possible, but no later than the legal deadline of 30 days. We usually manage it much faster, as we do all the servicing ourselves in our workshop.

ProductFaq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
ProductFaq.faq1Content: Fast and secure delivery via Packeta (Zásilkovna). We offer a 14-day return policy on all orders. To initiate a return, please contact our customer service team at info@vexxwatch.cz.
ProductFaq.faq2Title: Can I service any of your watches locally?
ProductFaq.faq2Content: Absolutely. We use world-respected Seiko movements from Japan. Since these are a gold standard in the watch world, they are easy to service. Any local watch shop can help you out, so you never have to worry about finding a pro to keep it running like clockwork.
ProductFaq.faq3Title: Are your watches fakes and will they feel cheap in hand?
ProductFaq.faq3Content: Absolutely not. We build our watches using premium materials typically found in much more expensive timepieces – such as high-grade surgical steel (316L and 904L), scratch-resistant sapphire crystals, and reliable automatic movements. These are not fakes or cheap replicas. They are hand-assembled custom builds inspired by iconic designs. When you hold them, you immediately feel the solid weight and quality you'd expect from a proper watch.
